name: web-black-white-team-card-stack-with-gradient-highlight-and-doctor-portrait
title: Team Card Stack with Gradient Highlight
whatItIs: A split image: a black panel with a stack of white cards for a team list where the front card is a lilac and blue gradient with a circular portrait of a doctor inside a dotted ring, name, role and number, and a white panel with a cut-out doctor and a name card over the lower body.
whatItMeans: A stack with one highlighted card shows a selected item, and the gradient plus ring makes the profile the focus.
techniques: Stack of cards with one lifted gradient card
Portrait in a circle with a dotted ring
Names and numbers in the lower corners
Cut-out portrait with a frosted name card
Black panel contrasted with white panel

vocabulary.definition: Overlapping cards showing a list in layers.
A circle of small ticks around an avatar.
A frosted card with a person's name and role.
